description.en: The biggest questions of all — how the universe began, what it's made of, how it grows, and how it might one day end.
description.hr: Najveća pitanja od svih — kako je svemir počeo, od čega je sastavljen, kako raste i kako bi jednog dana mogao završiti.

back.en: The event that began our universe about 13.8 billion years ago — not an explosion in space, but the rapid expansion of space itself.
back.hr: Događaj koji je započeo naš svemir prije oko 13,8 milijardi godina — ne eksplozija u prostoru, nego naglo širenje samog prostora.

back.en: About 13.8 billion years. If that were a single year, all of human history would fit in the last few seconds.
back.hr: Oko 13,8 milijardi godina. Kad bi to bila jedna godina, cijela ljudska povijest stala bi u zadnjih nekoliko sekundi.

front.hr: Da li se svemir još širi?

back.en: Yes — and faster over time. Distant galaxies are racing away from us, and the expansion is accelerating.
back.hr: Da — i sve brže s vremenom. Daleke galaksije jure od nas, a širenje se ubrzava.

back.en: Invisible matter that doesn't emit light but has gravity. It makes up about 27% of the universe — and we still don't know what it is.
back.hr: Nevidljiva materija koja ne emitira svjetlost ali ima gravitaciju. Čini oko 27% svemira — a još ne znamo što je.

back.en: A mysterious force pushing the universe to expand ever faster. It's about 68% of everything — yet almost a total mystery.
back.hr: Tajanstvena sila koja gura svemir da se širi sve brže. Čini oko 68% svega — a gotovo potpuna zagonetka.

front.en: What is ordinary matter's share of the universe?
front.hr: Koliki je udio obične materije u svemiru?

back.en: Everything we can see — stars, planets, people — is only about 5%. The other 95% is dark matter and dark energy.
back.hr: Sve što možemo vidjeti — zvijezde, planete, ljudi — je samo oko 5%. Ostalih 95% je tamna materija i tamna energija.

front.en: What is the cosmic microwave background?
front.hr: Što je kozmičko mikrovalno pozadinsko zračenje?

back.en: The faint afterglow of the Big Bang, still filling all of space. It's the oldest light we can detect — a baby photo of the universe.
back.hr: Slabi sjaj koji je ostao nakon Velikog praska, još ispunjava sav prostor. Najstarija svjetlost koju možemo otkriti — bebina slika svemira.

media.image_hint: NASA/WMAP ili ESA/Planck mapa kosmickog mikrovalnog zracenja. Trazi 'cosmic microwave background WMAP' na images.nasa.gov (WMAP je NASA, cisto). Planck je ESA — provjeri.

front.en: What was the universe like at the very beginning?
front.hr: Kakav je svemir bio na samom početku?

back.en: Unimaginably hot and dense — smaller than an atom, then expanding enormously in a fraction of a second.
back.hr: Nezamislivo vruć i gust — manji od atoma, pa se ogromno proširio u djeliću sekunde.

front.en: When did the first stars appear?
front.hr: Kad su se pojavile prve zvijezde?

back.en: Roughly 100–200 million years after the Big Bang. Before them, the universe was dark — an era called the 'cosmic dark ages'.
back.hr: Otprilike 100–200 milijuna godina nakon Velikog praska. Prije njih, svemir je bio taman — doba zvano 'kozmičko mračno doba'.

back.en: One leading idea is the 'Big Freeze': it keeps expanding and cooling until stars die out and everything fades into cold darkness.
back.hr: Jedna vodeća ideja je 'Veliko smrzavanje': nastavlja se širiti i hladiti dok zvijezde ne izumru i sve utrne u hladnu tamu.

front.en: Can we see the edge of the universe?

back.en: We see an 'observable' universe limited by how far light has traveled since the Big Bang. Beyond it, there may be far more we can never see.
back.hr: Vidimo 'vidljivi' svemir ograničen time koliko je svjetlost preputovala od Velikog praska. Iza njega možda ima još mnogo toga što nikad nećemo vidjeti.

front.en: What came before the Big Bang?
front.hr: Što je bilo prije Velikog praska?

back.en: We don't know — it may be beyond what science can currently answer. Time itself may have begun with the Big Bang.
back.hr: Ne znamo — možda je izvan onoga što znanost trenutno može odgovoriti. Samo vrijeme je možda počelo s Velikim praskom.
